name: 3d-galaxy-local-memory-graph
summary: Render local notes and unstructured memory in a interactive 3D galaxy graph visualizer running locally without incurring API storage or query fees.
steps: Store memory notes locally on the host machine as markdown or local vector nodes.
Launch the visual interface on localhost:4719 to render nodes in a 3D galaxy graph layout.
Perform fast local searches across graph memory nodes with zero external API call costs.
jarvis_use: Provide instant visual memory recall and contextual retrieval for local assistant operations without API costs.

name: preflight-testing-harness
summary: Run an automated live verification script against running services to ensure end-to-end reliability before assistant deployment.
steps: Execute preflight testing script (e.g. python preflight.py).
Check web server status and static asset availability.
Verify 3D knowledge graph database connectivity and ensure node count > 0.
Send a live test payload to active model API key and verify well-formed structured response.
Print a pass/fail verdict matrix across all subsystem chains.
jarvis_use: Validate local Mac server, database graph, and API connectivity prior to starting daily assistant sessions.

name: jev-reflex-routing
summary: Intercept simple reflex-style utility commands locally using zero-cost pattern matching before triggering large language model brains.
steps: Receive user voice/text input at local controller.
Pass input string to local JEV reflex match engine.
If string matches known command patterns (e.g. check calendar, pause timer, toggle UI mode), execute locally at <0.01¢ cost in ~0.2s.
If query requires deep reasoning or unstructured synthesis, forward context to main Anthropic API brain.
jarvis_use: Bypass LLM API calls for routine desktop automation commands to achieve instant sub-cent execution.

name: google-workspace-actions-integration
summary: Connect the assistant to Google Calendar, Gmail, Drive, and Sheets where tool execution is completely free and only LLM reasoning is metered.
steps: Authenticate local assistant via OAuth to Google Workspace APIs.
Construct intent parameters using the primary LLM reasoning brain.
Invoke free Google Workspace endpoints (Calendar event creation, Gmail sending, Drive lookup, Sheets logging).
Return API execution payload back to the local assistant UI.
jarvis_use: Execute productivity tasks across Google services while metering only the initial context reasoning tokens.

name: telegram-bot-voice-reminders
summary: Deliver voice notes and structured reminder notifications to mobile devices using a Telegram bot bridge.
steps: Set up a Telegram Bot token and connect to local assistant event stream.
Trigger reminder events from local scheduler or voice commands.
Convert reminder text to voice audio notes or formatted chat messages.
Push messages directly to the user's mobile Telegram chat interface.
jarvis_use: Provide instant off-grid phone notifications and audio reminders when away from the desktop screen.

name: holo-hand-gesture-posture-tracking
summary: Control local browser and desktop UI states using local webcam posture tracking, hand gestures, and text-to-speech audio feedback.
steps: Capture local webcam video feed inside local browser context.
Run lightweight local posture and HOLO hand gesture detection models.
Map specific gesture commands (e.g., hold up hand, shift pose) to UI state toggles and local browser TTS feedback.
Execute UI events without sending visual frames to external cloud APIs.
jarvis_use: Perform touchless UI control and posture monitoring directly on local hardware for free.

name: web-research-tool-synthesis
summary: Execute deep live web research and multi-step search query synthesis with explicit per-task token cost tracking.
steps: Receive complex research objective from prompt query.
Trigger search API tools to perform iterative web lookups.
Pass retrieved web page contents into Claude Sonnet thinking context for synthesis.
Format output into structured research reports while logging token consumption (~6¢ per deep task).
jarvis_use: Automate background market and technical research with clear operational cost visibility.

name: telegram-invoice-extraction-pipeline
summary: Extract key financial metadata from PDF invoices sent via Telegram and organize files into Google Drive folders.
steps: Receive PDF invoice attachment via incoming Telegram message.
Parse PDF document layout using local vision or document parsing tools.
Extract structured line-item figures, dates, and vendor details.
Save extracted record to Google Sheets and upload source document to Google Drive.
jarvis_use: Automate mobile expense logging and document archiving via chat interface.

name: metered-brain-switching
summary: Dynamically switch underlying LLM brains by voice or UI controls based on task complexity and prepaid API budgets.
steps: Monitor required reasoning depth of incoming task.
Toggle active model selection badge in control HUD (e.g. Sonnet 5.5 for balanced tasks, Haiku for quick computer control, Opus for heavy synthesis).
Route subsequent API calls through selected model endpoint while retaining local session state and 3D memory access.
jarvis_use: Optimize token expenditure by switching between fast lightweight models and deep reasoning models on the fly.

name: webcam-vision-frame-analysis
summary: Analyze physical environment context by passing periodic webcam snapshots to multi-modal vision models while tracking token costs.
steps: Capture high-resolution snapshot from connected USB/built-in webcam.
Compress image payload and attach to multi-modal LLM request prompt.
Process visual context (e.g., desktop setup inspection, object identification).
Display output result in assistant stream while calculating image token costs (~15¢ Sonnet / ~8¢ Haiku).
jarvis_use: Provide physical real-world awareness and vision inspection to the AI assistant on demand.

name: vision-assisted-computer-takeover
summary: Drive desktop applications using multi-step screen capture vision loops and simulated input control.
steps: Grant screen capture permissions via browser modal (`localhost:4719`).
Initiate computer takeover task from prompt command.
Capture periodic screen snapshots sent to multi-modal vision model (~15¢ on Sonnet, ~8¢ on Haiku).
Parse bounding box coordinates for UI elements and emit mouse movement, click, and typing actions (`JARVIS IS DRIVING`).
Halt execution loop when target end-state is verified visually.
jarvis_use: Enable autonomous desktop navigation and multi-step web browser tasks directly on the user's computer.

name: retell-ai-telephony-integration
summary: Integrate Retell AI telephony infrastructure with budget voice and LLM engines for automated outbound/inbound phone calls.
steps: Provision dedicated US telephone number in Retell ($2/month).
Configure Retell voice engine (5.5¢/min) with selected TTS model (standard 1.5¢/min or ElevenLabs 4¢/min).
Attach lightweight LLM (GPT-4o-mini or Haiku at <1-2.5¢/min) for real-time conversational responses.
Trigger call workflows for restaurant bookings, client hotlines, or urgent mobile callouts (~9-14¢/min total).
jarvis_use: Provide Mac assistant with low-cost outbound landline call capability for errand booking and emergency phone alerts.
